_doc: Flow facts of application E (pkt-sim/software/ucx-os/app/weird_a.c) for rttools.wcet, with ucx-os.json. tcb = 5: PE 0-0 holds F, D, B, A and the idle task (the largest PE of the mapping). heap_blocks: blocks of the heap of the largest PE: 1 end block, 3 per task and for the idle task (tcb, rt, stack; kernel/ucx.c), 2 per comm (queue and slots; lib/queue.c), 1 per output packet (create_pkt) and 2 packets in flight per input edge between PEs (rttools.ucxgen memory, --in-flight): 29 on PE 0-0, bound 32.

task_j._doc: J joins G, H and I: one job receives at most one packet per input (the k-th packet of each producer, FIFO queues) and tests the condition once more: 4 executions of the header of the loop that calls recv_source_port (rttools.wcet.ucx bounds the receives of a job by the in-degree as well)
